metadata.title: IELTS Practice
metadata.description: IELTS vocabulary with spaced repetition and step-by-step Writing Task 1 and 2 practice, made for Vietnamese learners.

landing.heroTitle: Learn the words. Then write with them.
landing.heroSubtitle: Flashcards that come back just before you forget them, and guided practice for Writing Task 1 and 2: start from Vietnamese, write sentence by sentence, and finish with an estimated band.
landing.featureSrsBody: The same scheduling method as Anki (FSRS) brings each word back just before you would forget it.
landing.featureAudioBody: Listen to the word and every example in a British or American accent, read aloud by your browser.
landing.featureImageBody: Most words come with a photo next to the meaning, so new words are easier to recall.
landing.featureCardsBody: Paste a list of words or pick a topic, and get word forms, Vietnamese meanings, collocations and examples.
landing.closingTitle: A few minutes of review and one paragraph a day
landing.closingBody: Sign in with Google and start with the words and writing tasks you need for your target band.
landing.footer: Made for IELTS learners in Vietnam and everywhere else.
landing.vocabGroupBody: Learn words in context, and keep them.
landing.writingGroupBody: Guided Task 1 and Task 2 practice that starts from where you are.
landing.featurePlanBody: Short questions in Vietnamese help you understand the task and see the plan of the answer before you write a word.
landing.featureSentencesBody: Write each sentence in English. Any correct answer is accepted, and word-for-word translation mistakes are explained.
landing.featureBandTitle: A full answer and an estimated band
landing.featureBandBody: Put your sentences together, then get comments on the four IELTS criteria, the three most useful fixes and a model answer.
landing.featureTasksBody: Practise with tasks based on the Cambridge IELTS books, with less help each time you are ready for more.

settings.timezoneHelp: Your daily reviews reset at the start of your study day in this time zone.

settings.relearningStepsHelp: How soon a forgotten card comes back, e.g. “10m”.

plan.help: Answer these questions in Vietnamese before you write.

promptHelp.1: Write each Vietnamese sentence in English. Any correct English is fine; it does not have to match the model.

promptHelp.3: Each line gives English key words. Build a full sentence from them.
